methods.label: Take the opposite of each coordinate
methods.explanation: For points symmetric about the origin, both the x-coordinates and the y-coordinates are opposites. The point symmetric to \((3,-2)\) is \((-3,2)\).
methods.levelReason: This directly applies the Grade 9 coordinate rule for symmetry about the origin.
